PowerPlantOfficer1AThiefBrokeInText:
A thief broke into
the POWER PLANT…

What is the world
coming to?
PowerPlantOfficer1CeruleanShadyCharacter:
I just got word
from CERULEAN.

It appears that a
shady character

has been loitering
around.
PowerPlantOfficer1CouldIAskForYourCooper:
Could I ask for
your cooperation?
PowerPlantOfficer1HaveToBeefUpSecurityTe:
We'll have to beef
up our security presence.
PowerPlantGymGuide1SomeoneStoleAPartText:
Someone made off
with a part that's

essential for the
generator.

Without it, the
new generator's useless!
PowerPlantGymGuide1GeneratorUpAndRunning:
The generator's up
and running. It's

making electricity
to spare.
PowerPlantGymGuide2PowerPlantUpAndRunnin:
This POWER PLANT
had been abandoned in the past.

We got it back up
and running to

provide power to
the MAGNET TRAIN.
PowerPlantOfficer2ManagerHasBeenSadAndFu:
The POWER PLANT's
MANAGER is up ahead.

But since someone
wrecked the gener- ator, he's been both sad and furious…
PowerPlantOfficer2ManagerHasBeenCheerful:
Since the gener-
ator's been fixed,

the MANAGER has
been cheerful.
PowerPlantGymGuide4MagnetTrainConsumesEl:
The MAGNET TRAIN
consumes a lot of electricity.

It can't move if
the new generator isn't operating.
PowerPlantGymGuide4WeCanGetMagnetTrainRu:
All right! We can
finally get the

MAGNET TRAIN
running again.
PowerPlantManagerWhoWouldRuinMyGenerator:
MANAGER: I, I, I'm
ready to blast someone!

Who would dare
ruin my generator?

I spent so much
time on it!

If I catch him,
he's going to get

a taste of my ZAP
CANNON!
PowerPlantManagerIWontForgiveCulpritText:
MANAGER: I won't
forgive him!

The culprit can
cry and apologize,

but I'll still
hammer him!

Gahahahah!
PowerPlantManagerThatsThePartText:
MANAGER: Ah! Yeah!

That's the missing
PART from my be- loved generator! You found it?
PowerPlantManagerTakeThisTMText:
Wahah! Thanks!

Here! Take this TM
as a reward!
PowerPlantManagerTM07IsZapCannonText:
MANAGER: TM07 is
my ZAP CANNON.

It's a powerful
technique!

It's not what any-
one would consider

accurate, but it
packs a wallop!
PowerPlantManagerMyBelovedGeneratorText:
MANAGER: My be-
loved generator!

Keep pumping the
electricity out!
